name: North Andover
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in North Andover, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in North Andover, MA: Santa's Workshop with Mr. and Mrs. Claus, reindeer food and cookie decorating at Smolak Farms.
lede: North Andover's Christmas runs on volunteers and a family farm: the Festival Committee's Santa Parade and Town Common tree lighting, and a barn full of Santa crafts at Smolak Farms.
celebrates: The North Andover Festival Committee kicks off the season with the annual Santa Parade and a tree lighting on the Town Common, where families have found an ice sculpture, hot cocoa and treats. The committee also hosts Crafts and Cocoa with Santa at the Stevens Estate. The town runs a Holiday Lights Map so families can tour decorated homes, the Police Department collects food in its Cram-A-Cruiser drive and the Fire Department gathers new toys for local children. At Smolak Farms, Mr. and Mrs. Claus spend December weekends in the barn with crafts, stories and photos.
lastyear: In 2025 the town listed the Annual Santa Parade for Saturday, November 29, at noon and the Annual Tree Lighting for Sunday, November 30, at 4 pm. The Festival Committee named John Lyons Sr. as Grand Marshal of the parade and Master of Ceremonies for the tree lighting. Residents could add their homes to the 2025 Holiday Lights Map until December 23, police collected food donations at Market Basket on three December Saturdays and the Fire Department took toys at Station 1 through December 13.
facts: Smolak Farms, home of North Andover's Santa's Workshop, has been in the same family since Martin and Magdalenna Smolak's time, and parts of the homestead are about 300 years old. In 1982 the family protected 107 of its 160 acres through the state's Agricultural Preservation Restriction program, so that land can never be developed. The farm stand opened in 1985 on the spot of an old chicken coop built by the grandfather, and the bakery that started that same year is now known for cider doughnuts.
trains: North Andover has no Commuter Rail station of its own. Families ride the MBTA Haverhill Line from Andover or Lawrence, the two closest stops, into North Station in Boston, passing Ballardvale, Reading and Malden Center on the way. For a train outing, Lowell has the Boston and Maine Railroad Historical Society's steam locomotive No. 410 and the National Streetcar Museum, and Edaville in Carver runs a Holiday Express train through acres of Christmas lights.

traditions: The North Andover Festival Committee brings Santa to town with its annual parade, led by a Grand Marshal chosen each year.
Tree Lighting on the Town Common
The committee lights the town tree on the Common with music, hot cocoa and treats.
Residents and businesses sign up their decorated homes, and the town shares a map families can use for a lights drive.
Cram-A-Cruiser and the Fire Department Toy Drive
Police collect food at Market Basket and firefighters collect new, unwrapped toys at Fire Station 1 on Chickering Road.

kidfact: The farm stand at Smolak Farms stands where an old chicken coop used to be, and the building first served as a garage for trucks, with a shelter out back for cows waiting to have their calves.
faq: When is the North Andover Santa Parade?

The North Andover Festival Committee holds the Santa Parade on Thanksgiving weekend. In 2025 the town listed it for Saturday, November 29, at noon, with John Lyons Sr. serving as Grand Marshal. The tree lighting followed the next day. Check the Festival Committee and town pages for this year's route and time.
Where is the North Andover tree lighting?

The Festival Committee lights the town tree on the Town Common, usually the day after the Santa Parade. In 2025 it was Sunday, November 30, at 4 pm. Recent lightings have featured an ice sculpture, hot cocoa and treats, and the parade's Grand Marshal has served as master of ceremonies.
How do I find holiday lights in North Andover?

The town publishes a Holiday Lights Map each December. Residents and businesses register their address through a town form, and the map link goes out in early December and updates daily with new homes. In 2025 sign-ups stayed open until December 23, so the map kept growing right up to Christmas.
Can kids meet Santa at Smolak Farms?

Yes. Smolak Farms runs Santa's Workshop in its barn on weekends in late November and December. Children meet Mr. and Mrs. Claus, make crafts such as ornaments and Santa hats, write a letter to Santa and hear a story from Mrs. Claus. Tickets are sold for set start times.
Which train station is closest to North Andover?

North Andover does not have its own Commuter Rail stop. The closest stations are Andover and Lawrence on the MBTA Haverhill Line, which runs to North Station in Boston. Trains on the line also stop at Ballardvale, Reading and Malden Center on the way into the city.
